# Variant calls preparation

## Software requirments 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggpubr)
```

## 1. General QC 

### Coverage General 

```{r}
## Cohort 2
coverage_2 <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_2_openbis/cohort_2_openbis_overview.tsv")
coverage_2$cohort <- "cohort_new"
coverage_2$tissue_treatment <- "FFPE"

## Cohort 1
coverage_1 <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_1_ena/cohort_1_ena_overview.tsv")
coverage_1$cohort <- "cohort_old"

# Select tumor samples 
coverage_1 <- coverage_1 %>% filter(sample_type == "TU")
coverage_1$sample <- coverage_1$sample_title

## Combine
colnames_shared <- colnames(coverage_1)[colnames(coverage_1) %in% colnames(coverage_2)]

coverage_all <- rbind(coverage_1 %>% select(all_of(colnames_shared)), coverage_2 %>% select(all_of(colnames_shared)))
```


```{r}
# Select columns of interest
coverage_filtered <- coverage_all %>% select(sample, cohort, multiqc_general.median_coverage, multiqc_general.mean_coverage,multiqc_general.5_x_pc, rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.median_coverage, rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.mean_coverage, rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.5_x_pc)
```


```{r}
## MOSDEPTH coverage across gene panel

# Median coverages
ggplot(coverage_filtered, aes(x = multiqc_general.median_coverage))+
  geom_density(aes(fill = cohort), alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_rug(aes(color = cohort))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

# Mean coverages
ggplot(coverage_filtered, aes(x = multiqc_general.mean_coverage))+
  geom_density(aes(fill = cohort), alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_rug(aes(color = cohort))+
  theme_classic()+

  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

# 5x coverage percentage
ggplot(coverage_filtered, aes(x = multiqc_general.5_x_pc))+
  geom_density(aes(fill = cohort), alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_rug(aes(color = cohort))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
```


#### Correlation Mean / Target Coverage 

```{r}
coverage_comp <- data.frame(sample = coverage_filtered$sample, mean_cov = coverage_filtered$multiqc_general.mean_coverage, mean_cov_rcc = coverage_filtered$rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.mean_coverage)

spearman_test <- cor.test(coverage_comp$mean_cov, coverage_comp$mean_cov_rcc)

ggplot(coverage_comp, aes(mean_cov, mean_cov_rcc))+
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x, se = TRUE, color = "darkgrey")+
  geom_point(size = 2)+
  theme_classic()+
  ggtitle(paste("Pearson = ",round(spearman_test$estimate, digits = 2)))

coverage_comp <- data.frame(sample = coverage_filtered$sample, mean_cov = coverage_filtered$multiqc_general.5_x_pc, mean_cov_rcc = coverage_filtered$rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.5_x_pc)

spearman_test <- cor.test(coverage_comp$mean_cov, coverage_comp$mean_cov_rcc)

ggplot(coverage_comp, aes(mean_cov, mean_cov_rcc))+
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x, se = TRUE, color = "darkgrey")+
  geom_point(size = 2)+
  theme_classic()+
  ggtitle(paste("Pearson = ",round(spearman_test$estimate, digits = 2)))
```


#### Filter criteria 

```{r}
## Average coverage per PID
coverage_filtered$PID <- str_split(coverage_filtered$sample, "_TU", simplify = TRUE)[,1]

# Here for overall mean coverage
coverage_PID <- coverage_filtered %>% group_by(PID) %>% summarise(mean_cov = mean(multiqc_general.mean_coverage), 
                                                                  cov_rcc_5 = mean(rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.5_x_pc))
```

```{r}
PID_kick_out <- coverage_PID %>% filter(cov_rcc_5 < 15) %>% pull(PID) #n=5
```

## 2. Cohort 2 - OpenBIS 

### Per patient

```{r}
path <- c("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_2_openbis/02_variant_calling/variant_tables/")

# List all files
files <- list.files(path)

# Extract ID
PID <- str_split(files, "_B", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
```

```{r}
# Create combined variant table 
variant_combined <- foreach(i = seq_along(files), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
   variant_table <- read_tsv(paste0(path, files[i]))
  # Add ID 
  variant_table$PID <- PID[i]
  # Add type (SNV, Indel) and consequence from Annotation 
  variant_table$variant_type <- str_split(variant_table$Annotation,"[|;]", simplify = TRUE)[,12]
  variant_table$variant_consequence <- str_split(variant_table$Annotation,"\\|", simplify = TRUE)[,4]
  return(variant_table)
}
```

#### Match identifiers

```{r}
# Load patient metadata from IMC 
patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)

patient_meta <- patient_meta %>% filter(type == "primary")
```

```{r}
ID_match_new <- data.frame(PID_old =unique(variant_combined$PID))

ID_match_new$PID <- str_replace(ID_match_new$PID_old, "B0", "B200")
ID_match_new$PID <- str_replace(ID_match_new$PID, "B1", "B201")
ID_match_new$PID <- str_replace(ID_match_new$PID, "B9", "B199")

ID_match_new$PID <- str_replace(ID_match_new$PID, "_",".")        
ID_match_new$PID <- str_split(ID_match_new$PID, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]

ID_match_new$PID_in_IMC <- ID_match_new$PID %in% patient_meta$PID

write_csv(ID_match_new, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/cohort2_PID_matching.csv")
```

```{r}
# Re-enter after manual editing
ID_match_new <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/cohort2_PID_matching_LM.csv")
ID_match_new$PID_in_IMC <- ID_match_new$PID %in% patient_meta$PID

write_csv(ID_match_new, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/cohort2_PID_matching.csv")

## Add new PID to variant_combined
variant_combined$PID_old <- variant_combined$PID
variant_combined$PID <- ID_match_new$PID[match(variant_combined$PID,ID_match_new$PID_old)]
```

```{r}
write_csv(variant_combined, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_combined_cohort2.csv")
#variant_combined <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_combined_cohort2.csv")
```

### Filter 

```{r}
# Kick out PID with low coverage across RCC targets
summary(PID_kick_out %in% variant_combined$PID)
#variant_combined <- variant_combined[variant_combined$PID %in% PID_kick_out,]
```

```{r}
# ccRCC mutational driver genes 
GOI_IntOGen <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/IntOGen_DriverGenes_CCRCC.tsv")
GOI <- GOI_IntOGen$Symbol #n = 44
```

```{r}
# Split genes column into two rows in case it contains two gene names
variant_combined <- variant_combined %>%
  separate_rows(Genes, sep = ";") %>%
  unnest(cols = everything())

# Check variants called with VAF == 100 
## Possible to filter out - Potential SNPs 
vaf_100 <- variant_combined %>% filter(Frequency == 100)
vaf_100_GOI <- vaf_100 %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI)
## Optional: 
#variant_combined <- variant_combined %>% filter(Frequency != 100)

# Pick first mutation consequence 
variant_combined$variant_consequence_clean <- str_split(variant_combined$variant_consequence,"&", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
```

ENSEMBL-based 
Filter: Variants with MODERATE or HIGH impact only 
See: https://grch37.ensembl.org/info/genome/variation/prediction/predicted_data.html

```{r}
unique(variant_combined$variant_consequence_clean)

# Variants with MODERATE or HIGH impact
mutation_consequence <- c("splice_acceptor_variant","splice_donor_variant","stop_gained","frameshift_variant","stop_lost","start_lost","inframe_insertion","inframe_deletion","missense_variant","protein_altering_variant")

variant_combined_filtered <- variant_combined %>% filter(variant_consequence_clean %in% mutation_consequence)
```

```{r}
vaf_100 <- variant_combined_filtered %>% filter(Frequency == 100)
vaf_100_GOI <- vaf_100 %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI)
```

```{r}
variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined <- variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_clean

variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined[variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined %in% c("stop_gained", "stop_lost","start_lost")] <- "stop_gained_lost_start_lost" 
variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined[variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined %in% c("splice_donor_variant", "splice_acceptor_variant")] <- "splice_site"
variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined[variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined %in% c("inframe_deletion", "inframe_insertion")] <- "inframe_del_ins"
```

```{r}
write_csv(variant_combined_filtered, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_combined_filtered_cohort2.csv")
```


### Oncoprint

```{r}
#Load processed data file and select columns of interest
snv <- variant_combined_filtered
snv$mut_level <- snv$variant_consequence_combined

snv <- snv %>% select(PID, Genes, mut_level)

mut_levels_for_matrix <- snv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select genes 
## A: All genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
## B: Genes of Interest e.g. IntOGen driver genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()

#Placeholders 
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_Genes <- Genes_list[1]
pids <- unique(snv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]

for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  
  #select all SNVs/Indels of the mut_level and give a value of 1
  x <- snv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  Genes %in% Genes_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", Genes_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), Genes) |       #allow for multi-Genes mutations
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", Genes_list, "$"), collapse="|"), Genes) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, Genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(Genes, value)
    
    #transpose and replace NA by 0
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_Genes
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}

#Unify matrices
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)

# Create a new list entry called "Multiple" for multiple gene mutations within a PID
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))
```


```{r print onc, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,fig.width=10,fig.height=6}
# keep the order of annotation and mutation list
#ord= anno$PID_short
  
# show every gene and patient
# blank for patients  and.or genes missing 
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen= setdiff(Genes_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat= setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  #mut_list_full[[i]]=mut_list_full[[i]][,ord]
}

##Annotation
#Colors
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12,"Paired"))(length(unique(snv$mut_level)))

# alter_fun function 
fun_alter = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  missense_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[1], col = NA)),
  stop_gained_lost_start_lost = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[2], col = NA)),
  frameshift_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[3], col = NA)),
  inframe_del_ins = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[4], col = NA)),
  splice_site = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[5], col = NA)),
  protein_altering_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[6], col = NA)),
  multiple = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)

names(col) <- c("missense_variant", "stop_gained_lost_start_lost", "frameshift_variant", 
"inframe_del_ins", "splice_site", "protein_altering_variant")
test_alter_fun(fun_alter)

## Step 3: Row Annotation 
r_anno <- data.frame(genes = rownames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
r_anno$key_genes <- ifelse(r_anno$genes %in% c("VHL","PBRM1","BAP1","SETD2"), "key_driver", "other_driver")

#Plot oncoprint
ht_all <- oncoPrint(mut_list_full,
                    row_split = r_anno$key_genes,
                    alter_fun = fun_alter,
                    col = col)

draw(ht_all)
```


## 3. Cohort 1 - ENA 

### Per sample

```{r}
path <- c("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_1_ena/02_variant_calling/variant_tables/")

PID <- str_split(files, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
```

```{r}
# Create combined variant table 
variant_combined <- foreach(i = seq_along(files), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
   variant_table <- read_tsv(paste0(path, files[i]))
  # Add IDs
  variant_table$sample_id <- sample_id[i]

  # Add type (SNV, Indel) and consequence from Annotation

  return(variant_table)
}
```

### Consensus per patient

```{r}
# Option 1: Consensus per PID 
### Only select mutations that were detected in both samples (n=2) - independent of mutation type
consensus <- variant_combined %>% group_by(PID, sample_id) %>% select(Genes) %>% unique() %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID, Genes) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(n == 2)

variant_consensus <- foreach(i = unique(variant_combined$PID), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  genes_consensus <- consensus %>% filter(PID == i) %>% pull(Genes)
  variant_consensus <- variant_combined %>% filter(PID == i & Genes %in% genes_consensus)
  return(variant_consensus)
}
```


```{r}
# Option 2: Clonality annotation per PID
### If mutation is found in both samples - "Clonal" - Otherwise "Subclonal"
clonality <- variant_combined %>% group_by(PID, sample_id) %>% filter(!is.na(PID)) %>% select(Genes) %>% unique() %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID, Genes) %>% dplyr::count() %>% mutate(clonality = ifelse(n == 1, "subclonal", "clonal"))

clonality_consensus <- foreach(i = unique(variant_combined$PID), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  variant_consensus <- variant_combined %>% filter(PID == i)
  clonality_consensus <- clonality %>% filter(PID == i)
  variant_consensus$clonality <- clonality_consensus$clonality[match(variant_consensus$Genes, clonality_consensus$Genes)]
  return(variant_consensus)
}
```

```{r}
clonality_plot <- clonality_consensus %>% group_by(PID, clonality) %>% dplyr::count() %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = n/sum(n)) %>% filter(clonality == "clonal")

ggplot(clonality_plot, aes(x = clonality, y = fra))+
  geom_jitter(size = 2, position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1), aes(color = PID))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Clonal mutation percentage (all)")
```


```{r}
write_csv(variant_consensus, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_consensus_cohort1.csv")
write_csv(clonality_consensus, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_clonality_consensus_cohort1.csv")
```

```{r}
# Intra-tumor genomic heterogeneity index (ITH) for Driver Mutations
ITH_index <- variant_consensus %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% group_by(PID, clonality) %>% dplyr::count() %>% ungroup() %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "clonality", values_from = "n") %>% replace_na(list(clonal = 0, subclonal = 0)) %>% mutate(ITH_index = subclonal/clonal)

# Replace Inf with max(ITH_index)
ITH_index$ITH_index[ITH_index$ITH_index == Inf] <- max(ITH_index %>% filter(ITH_index != Inf) %>% pull(ITH_index))
ITH_index$group <- "ITH"

ggplot(ITH_index, aes(x = group, y = ITH_index))+
  geom_jitter(size = 2, position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1), aes(color = PID))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("ITH index (GOI)")
```

#### Oncoprint

```{r}
#Load processed data file and select columns of interest
snv <- variant_consensus_filtered
snv$mut_level <- snv$variant_consequence_combined

snv <- snv %>% select(PID, Genes, mut_level)

mut_levels_for_matrix <- snv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select genes 
## A: All genes 
#Genes_list <- snv %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()

## B: Genes of Interest e.g. IntOGen driver genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()

#Placeholders 
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_Genes <- Genes_list[1]
pids <- unique(snv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]

for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  
  #select all SNVs/Indels of the mut_level and give a value of 1
  x <- snv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  Genes %in% Genes_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", Genes_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), Genes) |       #allow for multi-Genes mutations
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", Genes_list, "$"), collapse="|"), Genes) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, Genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(Genes, value)
    
    #transpose and replace NA by 0
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_Genes
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}

#Unify matrices
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)

# Create a new list entry called "Multiple" for multiple gene mutations within a PID
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))


# Optional: Create a new list entry called "Clonality" for gene mutation clonality annotation per PID
subclonal_anno <- variant_consensus_filtered %>% select(PID, Genes, clonality) %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% unique() %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = Genes, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))

subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), colnames(subclonal_anno))]

mut_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno
```

```{r}
# Load patient metadata from IMC 
patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)

patient_meta <- patient_meta %>% filter(type == "primary")

# Re-group subtypes 
patient_meta$subtype_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$subtype %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC"), patient_meta$subtype, "other")
patient_meta$subtype_combined[patient_meta$subtype_combined == "clear_cell_RCC"] <- "ccRCC"
patient_meta$subtype_combined[patient_meta$subtype_combined == "papillary_RCC"] <- "pRCC"
patient_meta$subtype_combined[patient_meta$subtype_combined == "chromophobe_RCC"] <- "chrRCC"

## Update survival censoring
patient_meta$status_OS <- ifelse(patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 1, 0, 
       ifelse(patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 0, 1, patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1))

patient_meta$OS_months <- patient_meta$survival_months

## Combine relevant disease progression categories and set colors
### Tumor stage
patient_meta$pT_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(patient_meta$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", patient_meta$pT_simple))

### ISUP grade 
patient_meta$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$ISUP %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(patient_meta$ISUP %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", patient_meta$ISUP))
patient_meta$lymphocytes_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$lymphocytes %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", patient_meta$lymphocytes)
```

```{r print onc, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE, fig.width=10,fig.height=7}
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  missense_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[1], col = NA)),

  frameshift_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[3], col = NA)),
  inframe_del_ins = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[4], col = NA)),
  splice_site = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[5], col = NA)),
  protein_altering_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[7], col = NA)),
  multiple = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[6], col = NA)),
  subclonal = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)

names(col) <- c("missense_variant", "stop_gained_lost_start_lost", "frameshift_variant", 
"inframe_del_ins", "splice_site", "protein_altering_variant", "multiple")
test_alter_fun(fun_alter)

## Step 2: Column Annotation
c_anno <- data.frame(PID = colnames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
c_anno$cohort <- variant_combined_full$cohort[match(c_anno$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
c_anno$PID_old <- variant_combined_full$PID_old[match(c_anno$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
#c_anno$critical <- c_anno$PID_old %in% PID_kick_out

c_anno$gender <- variant_combined_full$gender[match(c_anno$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
c_anno$age_bin <- variant_combined_full$age_bin[match(c_anno$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
c_anno$ISUP_combined <- variant_combined_full$ISUP_combined[match(c_anno$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
c_anno$pT_combined <- variant_combined_full$pT_combined[match(c_anno$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
c_anno$necrose <- variant_combined_full$necrose[match(c_anno$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]

## 2A: Sequencing related data
### Define colors

                   )

                                      PDL1 = PDL1_col),

                           )

## Step 3: Row Annotation

r_anno$key_genes <- ifelse(r_anno$genes %in% c("VHL","PBRM1","BAP1","SETD2"), "key_driver", "other_driver")
```

```{r}
# Create heatmap combining information from mutations and IHC scores
```

```{r}
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))
sum_matrix[mut_list_full$subclonal == 1] <- 0.5

# Select mutations of interest
driver_mat <- as.data.frame(t(sum_matrix)) %>% select(VHL, BAP1, PBRM1, SETD2, PTEN) %>% rownames_to_column("PID") 

# Add IHC scores
driver_mat$BAP1_IHC <- variant_combined_full$BAP1_IHC[match(driver_mat$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
driver_mat$PBRM1_IHC <- variant_combined_full$PBRM1_IHC[match(driver_mat$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
driver_mat$H3K36me_IHC <- variant_combined_full$H3K36me_IHC[match(driver_mat$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]

# Create two heatmaps for mutations and IHC scores
mut_mat <- driver_mat %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% select(VHL, BAP1, PBRM1, SETD2, PTEN) 
IHC_mat <- driver_mat %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% select(BAP1_IHC, PBRM1_IHC, H3K36me_IHC)

## Define colors

driver_mat_ordered <- driver_mat[col_order_ht,]
```

### Across progression

#### Genomic subtypes 

```{r}
# Binary genomic subtype matrix 
genome_matrix <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(driver_mat_anno$genomic_subtype, driver_mat_anno$PID))

  
# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each category
  perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","PDL1_score","necrose"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  #i = "ISUP_combined"
  if(i %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
    PID_high <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "1",]$PID)
    PID_low <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  }else{
    PID_high <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "3/4",]$PID)
    PID_low <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "1/2",]$PID)
  }  
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(genome_matrix, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }



isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")

# Visualize findings 

## Waterfall plot with ggplot
ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x = reorder(gene, -p_out), y = p_out, fill = odds_ratio > 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~category)+
  geom_segment(aes(xend = gene, y = 0, yend = p_out), color = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 21, color = "black", fill = ifelse(fisher_full$p_out > -log10(0.1) & fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1, "#E41A1C",
                                                                  ifelse(fisher_full$p_out < log10(0.1) & fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1, "#377EB8", "grey")))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  labs(x = "Genomic subtypes", y = "(-)log10(P-Value)")

## Dotplot with ggnewscale
library(ggnewscale)

# P-values at 0.1 
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category,levels = c("PDL1_score","necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))

ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=reorder(gene, -p_out), y = category,col = odds_ratio, size= -log10(p_value)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_value), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Genomic subtype")

# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category,levels = c("PDL1_score","necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))
                            
ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=reorder(gene, -p_out), y = category,col = odds_ratio, size= -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Genomic subtype")
```

### Mutation frequencies

#### Cohort

```{r}
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))
#sum_matrix[mut_list_full$subclonal == 1] <- 0.5
#sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))

# Cohort identifiers
PID_new <- variant_combined_full %>% filter(cohort == "cohort_new") %>% pull(PID) %>% unique()
PID_older <- variant_combined_full %>% filter(cohort == "cohort_old") %>% pull(PID) %>% unique()
```

```{r}
# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
  contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
  contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
  contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
  contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
  contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
  test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
  return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
}

# Perform Fisher exact tests for each gene
fisher_results <- apply(sum_matrix, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_new, group2_cols = PID_older)

fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)

fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
colnames(fisher_results) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj")

isGreater <- fisher_results$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_results$p_adj)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_results$p_out <- pVal


# Visualize findings with ggplot2
ggplot(fisher_results, aes(x = reorder(gene, -p_out), y = p_out, fill = odds_ratio > 1)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = gene, y = 0, yend = p_out), color = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 21, color = "black", fill = ifelse(fisher_results$p_out > -log10(0.05) & fisher_results$odds_ratio > 1, "#E41A1C",
                                                                  ifelse(fisher_results$p_out < log10(0.05) & fisher_results$odds_ratio < 1, "#377EB8", "grey")))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  labs(x = "Genes", y = "(-)log10(P-Value)")
```

```{r}
  sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)

  perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)

    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)

  }
  
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","PDL1_score","necrose"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  if(i %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
    PID_high <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "1",]$PID)
    PID_low <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  }else{
    PID_high <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "3/4",]$PID)
    PID_low <- unique(variant_combined_full[variant_combined_full[, i] == "1/2",]$PID)
  }  
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(sum_matrix, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }
```

### Co-occurence analysis 

```{r}
# Co-occurence analysis 
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))

#sum_matrix <- sum_matrix[rownames(sum_matrix) %in% c("VHL","SETD2","BAP1","PBRM1","PTEN"),]

# P-value and odds ratio estimate 
co_occurrence_results <- list()
ma <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(sum_matrix), ncol = nrow(sum_matrix))
rownames(ma) <- rownames(sum_matrix)
colnames(ma) <- rownames(sum_matrix)
co_occurrence_results[[1]] <- ma
co_occurrence_results[[2]] <- ma
names(co_occurrence_results) <- c("p_value", "odds")

for (i in seq_along(rownames(sum_matrix))) {
  for (j in seq_along(rownames(sum_matrix))) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(sum_matrix[i,] == 1 & sum_matrix[j,] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(sum_matrix[i,] == 1 & sum_matrix[j,] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(sum_matrix[i,] == 0 & sum_matrix[j,] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(sum_matrix[i,] == 0 & sum_matrix[j,] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    co_occurrence_results$p_value[rownames(sum_matrix)[i], rownames(sum_matrix)[j]] <- test_result$p.value
    co_occurrence_results$odds[rownames(sum_matrix)[i], rownames(sum_matrix)[j]] <- test_result$estimate
  }
}


# Convert results to a data frame
library(reshape2)
co_occurrence_df <- melt(co_occurrence_results)
colnames(co_occurrence_df) <- c("Gene1", "Gene2", "Value","Type")
co_occurrence_df <- co_occurrence_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = Value)
# Filter out self-comparisons (diagonal) and duplicates
co_occurrence_df <- co_occurrence_df[co_occurrence_df$Gene1 != co_occurrence_df$Gene2, ]
co_occurrence_df$Gene1 <- as.character(co_occurrence_df$Gene1) 
co_occurrence_df$Gene2 <- as.character(co_occurrence_df$Gene2) 
co_occurrence_df <- co_occurrence_df %>%
  mutate(pair = ifelse(Gene1 < Gene2, paste(Gene1, Gene2, sep = "_"), paste(Gene2, Gene1, sep = "_"))) %>% arrange(pair) %>% dplyr::slice(seq(2, n(), by = 2))

# Adjust p-value
co_occurrence_df$p_adj <- p.adjust(co_occurrence_df$p_value, method = "BH")

co_occurrence_df

# Visualize 
isGreater <- co_occurrence_df$odds > 1
pVal <- log10(co_occurrence_df$p_adj)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
co_occurrence_df$p_out <- pVal

# Visualize findings with ggplot2
co_occurrence_df_sig <- co_occurrence_df %>% filter(p_adj < 0.05)
ggplot(co_occurrence_df_sig, aes(x = reorder(pair, -p_out), y = p_out, fill = odds > 1)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = pair, y = 0, yend = p_out), color = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 21, color = "black", fill = ifelse(co_occurrence_df_sig$p_out > -log10(0.05) & co_occurrence_df_sig$odds > 1, "#E41A1C",
                                                                  ifelse(co_occurrence_df_sig$p_out < log10(0.05) & co_occurrence_df_sig$odds < 1, "#377EB8", "grey")))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  labs(x = "pairs", y = "(-)log10(P-Value)")
```

### Per mutation 

```{r}
# Only clonal
#mut_matrix <- as.data.frame(t(ifelse(sum_matrix == 1, TRUE, FALSE))) %>% rownames_to_column("PID") 
# Clonal + subclonal
mut_matrix <- as.data.frame(t(ifelse(sum_matrix > 0, TRUE, FALSE))) %>% rownames_to_column("PID") 

mut_matrix$status_OS <- variant_combined_full$status_OS[match(mut_matrix$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
mut_matrix$OS_months <- variant_combined_full$OS_months[match(mut_matrix$PID, variant_combined_full$PID)]
```

```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(mut_matrix %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = mut_matrix)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(sign = p_adj < 0.1, direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% arrange(desc(p_out)) #%>% filter(p < 0.05)

cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_plot %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = type, names_from = group, values_from = p_out) %>% column_to_rownames("type")

# Define color 
colours <- c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027")
breaks <- c(-2, 2, 0.5)
breaks <- seq(from = breaks[1], to = breaks[2], by = breaks[3])
pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colours)(length(breaks))
col <- colorRamp2(breaks, pal)

Heatmap(cur_surv_plot, col = col, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), name = "log10(p)")
```
